minutes_text:
Arts Comision

  Inglewood, California
  March 20, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on March 20, 2024.
Commissioner Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Olivia Alvitre –
  District 2, Commissioner Phyllis Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner Vicki Perryman-
  Banks - District 4, Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large.

  Absent: None

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

SPECIAL PRESENTATION. None

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. It was moved by Commissioner Metcalf and seconded by Commissioner Banks
that the minutes for the Arts Commission meeting held on November 15, 2023, be
approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioner Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, Banks and Lesure
Noes: None

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Public art conservation (RFQ) for history of transportation & conch shell
  purchasing reviewed, processed and refined the process. It was voided and
  restarted. Due to multiple issues and how outreach is done, copies and digital
  copies are need.
  b. Percentage of Art Book will mark its 20th Anniversary in September. 20 years of
  history, projected publishing ordinance date: starts 3/29, finished by August.
  c. Forum Update: publication was pared over 25 medallions. Planning for the
  department to formally send notice to owner.

  1
   Arts Comision

PUBLIC REMARKS. Jorge Gomez is an Inglewood Open Studios Board Member and a brand
designer and graffiti artist. He is excited to find ways on how to work with the city. Patricia
Miller, owner of grocery outlet started a fundraising program for those who want to raise
funds. Five (5) percent of sales will be donated to the fundraiser.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR. Commissioner Alvitre
thanked the community for coming and speaking. Commissioner Metcalf is working on
bringing more spoken word events to the city. She is currently doing more research, is
interested in hosting storytelling and poetry reading for seniors at the Senior Center and
at the Library.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Lesure declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:02 p.m.
